heading: Thursday, December 5, 2024
topLine: Renaissance Philanthropy and XTX Markets launch $9.2m AI for Math Fund.

items.headline: Renaissance Philanthropy and XTX Markets launch $9.2m AI for Math Fund
items.summary: Renaissance Philanthropy and XTX Markets, the founding donor, announced a $9.2 million fund for AI tools that serve as long-term infrastructure for mathematics. Terence Tao, an advisor to the fund, was quoted saying next-generation AI tools could enhance collaboration among mathematicians.
